Основный Углекислый Алюминий Profile Basic aluminium carbonate is a combination of aluminium hy- droxide and aluminium carbonate. It is an antacid with general properties similar to those of aluminium hydroxide (below). Basic aluminium carbonate has also been given orally as a phos- phate binder in the treatment of hyperphosphataemia.
